finding: Secondary hyperparathyroidism was found in 40.3% of very premature infants, with cesarean section, oxygen resuscitation, invasive ventilation, anemia requiring transfusion, lower serum calcium, higher serum phosphate, and lower urine calcium/creatinine ratio identified as independent risk factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was an independent risk factor for secondary hyperparathyroidism in preterm infants.
